checked-by.alt: A Teams answer from the Lemma that ends with which page it came from, and who checked it when

stale-held-back.alt: A page past its check date: the team still gets it with a warning, a customer is passed to a person

miss-to-answer.alt: Four people asked about custom colours; the owner's reply comes back as a draft, saved as the answer in one press

walk.alt: Walking a procedure one step at a time: Done, I'm stuck, Stop

one-answer-two-places.alt: One answer serves the team's chat and a customer's Slack Connect, each told where it came from
